mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) may increase aripiprazole levels through reduced renal clearance and potential CYP3A4 inhibition, while aripiprazole may mask ototoxicity symptoms due to CNS effects.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess hearing regularly, and consider dose adjustment of aripiprazole if tobramycin is used; ensure adequate hydration to minimize nephrotoxicity.
